mechanism_narrative: A increase in GDP growth rate signals a strong economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with positive GDP growth, or GDP growth is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to higher wages and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances with low unemployment, or unemployment is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in the federal funds rate signal a strong economy and easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with positive housing starts and low federal funds rate, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances with positive industrial production, or industrial production is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index signal an easing monetary cycle and high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances with low federal funds rate and high inflation, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales signals a weak economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 30% of instances with low retail sales, or retail sales are not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with positive payroll employment, or payroll employment is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).
